sources.title: Pegasus · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pegasus is an encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) transformer model pretrained on unlabeled text to perform abstractive summarization. Pegasus is trained jointly on two self-supervised objective functions, masked language modeling (MLM) and gap sentence generation (GSG).

sources.title: GitHub - saki601/Filename_SQUATCH
sources.snippet: This project focuses on performing abstractive summarization and keyphrase generation on scientific abstracts using the google/pegasus-xsum model. We fine-tune the model efficiently using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), making it suitable for training on consumer-grade hardware such as Google Colab.
